description: Our game concept is space mission commander including mission objectives, space craft design, Scientific instruments, lunch vehicles, budgets, power, mass, communications, and orbital constrains. We will create an interactive game that allows participants to design, manage, and simulate a complete space mission while making engineering decisions, managing limited resources, and evaluating how each choice shape the success of their mission.
summary: Our project, A Mission to Mars, is a fun game made using Scratch. Players can plan their own trip to Mars. They can choose a rocket, build a spacecraft, pick tools, and manage money and power. They will also complete challenges and explore Mars. This game helps students learn about space, science, and how to solve problems. It makes learning fun and helps players understand how scientists plan space missions.
details: Our project, Mission Mars, is a fun game made using Scratch. Players plan a mission to Mars by choosing a rocket, building a spacecraft, and selecting tools. They must manage their money, power, and equipment carefully. The game helps students learn about space, science, and problem-solving. We used Scratch to design and code the game. Our idea is creative because it turns learning about space missions into an interactive game. We considered the mission goals, rocket size, spacecraft , budget, power, and communication.
